Ships a CLI, but blind-tester/run.sh has no launch branch for it and there is no reader for its session logs, so nothing here can PROVE what tools it saw: its sessions are hand-played and ingested, which is what operator_attested means. This becomes runner_enforced the day the runner can launch and audit it, and its earlier sessions keep their original, honest label.
